scope_basis: Guarantee on equity in a telecoms operator.
title: Orange Bissau S.A. – Telecoms Operator Guarantee (Sonatel equity)
description: MIGA guarantee to Sonatel SA covering its equity investment in Orange Bissau S.A., the telecoms operator in Guinea-Bissau. Part of the combined Orange Guinea and Guinea Bissau program (EUR 433.7M total across PIDs 14395, 15192, 14394). This tranche (PID 14394) covers $25.4M for telecom operations in Guinea-Bissau including mobile network operations. Risks: Expropriation, War and Civil Disturbance, Transfer Restriction. Approval FY2025.

scope_basis: National digital transformation programme implementing the digital strategy.
title: Mais Digit@l for Guinea-Bissau
description: National digital transformation programme for Guinea-Bissau addressing limited institutional capacities, inadequate digital infrastructure, significant gender disparities in digital literacy, and underdeveloped regulatory frameworks. Implementation of National Digital Transformation Strategy (ENTD.GW) developed with UNU-EGOV and UNDP. 2025-2030.
recipient_organisation: Government of Guinea-Bissau / Ministry of Digital Economy

scope_basis: National allocation under a regional digital integration programme.
title: World Bank — WARDIP SOP1, Guinea-Bissau, 2023
description: Guinea-Bissau's national allocation under the Digital Transformation for Africa / Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (DTfA/WARDIP) Series of Projects 1 (PAD4756, Operation ID P176932, 7 November 2023): "SDR 45.7 MILLION (US$60.0 MILLION EQUIVALENT) TO THE REPUBLIC OF GUINEA-BISSAU" as an IDA grant, plus a US$0.50m national-government counterpart contribution = US$60.50m total.
